artifact_consumer_policy.reason: Current B0/B1 manifests use these provider artifacts as custody/evidence products; no canonical acceptance contract identified a distinct downstream executable consumer as mandatory. Generic actions/download-artifact uses elsewhere do not establish consumption of these exact products.
artifact_consumer_policy.promotion_rule: If a canonical producer-consumer contract naming either artifact is later observed, reopen this field as TOKEN_VAZIO and require a provider-bound trace.

gap.missing_field: post-policy exact-head CI evidence + extraneous_count readback + aggregate receipt
gap.blocking_dependency: provider runs on the new branch head
gap.evidence_needed: changed-path equality, targeted governance PASS, workflow-contract PASS, aggregate exact-head receipt
gap.falsifier: unexpected changed path, failed gate, head mismatch, or newly observed mandatory consumer contract
gap.next_probe: read PR changed paths and exact-head workflow runs; issue aggregate receipt only if all gates pass
gap.closure_gate: hash-bound successor acceptance receipt with claim_allowed=false
